messages:
Jules (Acct Ops): Heads up — AcmeCorp invoice INV-2026-0421 failed to collect. Card on file declined and their attempted ACH setup bounced with a routing mismatch. Need plan.
Alex Chen: Which card + decline code? last4?
Jules (Acct Ops): Visa **** 4242 declined (3DS failure / auth refused). They also tried to add ACH but microdeposits unverified and bank returned 'invalid routing number'.
payments-bot: Auto-retry scheduled in 24h for INV-2026-0421 (3 attempts remaining).
Nora (Billing): Let's hold off auto-retries for now — repeated attempts can lock accounts. @Samir Patel can you reach out to the AM/customer?
Samir Patel: On it. I'll DM the customer. If they need to close the invoice today we can offer wire fallback — do we have EMEA wire template?
Jules (Acct Ops): We do. Sending masked instructions to share with customer — include invoice ref and remittance email.
Jules (Acct Ops): ```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
IBAN: GBxx XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XX
BIC: RBWDGB2L
Bank: Redwood Bank PLC (mock)
Reference: INV-2026-0421 / AcmeCorp
Remittance: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please email remittance copy to billing@redwood.ai so we can reconcile automatically.
```
Jules (Acct Ops): Also ask them to include the invoice number in the transfer reference so reconciliation is automated.
Samir Patel: Customer prefers ACH but admitted they entered the wrong routing. I'll ask for a voided check or their ACH authorization PDF. If they can't provide it quickly, will push wire.
Alex Chen: If they wire, finance will reconcile manually. Who removes credit hold after wire? Also what do we do for failed CC auth records? Need to log in ledger.
Nora (Billing): Credit-hold removal is manual in Stripe/DB. I can do it once remittance is confirmed and txn id is posted. For failed CC: we keep the decline record on the invoice and mark retry attempts — no auto-refund.
Jules (Acct Ops): Added a note to INV-2026-0421 in the ledger with timestamps and attempted methods. If wire received, tag the invoice with bank txn id for audit.
payments-bot: Wire fallback acknowledged — tagging #support for reconciliation help. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Assigned to me — will update thread after customer reply.
Samir Patel: Update: Customer uploaded ACH authorization PDF and verified microdeposits. They asked to cancel the wire. Can we re-run the ACH charge now? @payments-bot
payments-bot: Manual retry queued: attempting immediate debit of ACH on file for INV-2026-0421.
Nora (Billing): Please keep me posted. If it fails again we'll escalate to wire and document the decision path.
Samir Patel: Will report back within 2 hours.
